description: Retain an architecture-aware diagnostic adapter for Self-EvolveRec. DiagnosisProbe(view, device).run_full_diagnosis(train_loader) returns measured metrics and metric_definitions; diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis) explains those measurements and their limitations.
motivation: Use reproducible diagnostics to guide model improvements while preserving the four-category recommendation task and avoiding unsupported assumptions about unavailable reviews, item attributes, or simulator traits.
implementation_notes: Keep view.model bound to the trained nn.Module and adapt the compatibility methods when its architecture changes. Process batches shaped B × L, masking padding in every probe. Possible measurements include positive-versus-negative score margins, pairwise accuracy, embedding norms, and recommendation coverage. Use only available interaction histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps. Generate full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for twenty real training users, five per category. Select trials using macro-average validation HR@10 under the pinned evaluator; diagnostic measurements are not substitutes for that score. Preserve dataset routing, preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, GAGC_DATA_DIR, single-GPU execution, and matching predictor serialization. The effective default is SASREC_EPOCHS=200.
pseudocode:
class DiagnosisProbe:
    init(view, device): retain trained view and device
    run_full_diagnosis(train_loader):
        preserve model training state; enter evaluation mode
        with gradients disabled:
            for (_, sequence, positive, negative) in train_loader:
                features = view.log2feats(sequence)
                compute positive and negative scores through view.predict_score
                aggregate supported measurements over valid, nonpadding positions
            compute supported model and recommendation measurements
        restore model training state
        return {metrics: measured values, metric_definitions: definitions including masks, units, and sample counts}

function diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis):
    include measured metrics and their definitions
    distinguish observations from hypotheses
    identify unavailable evidence explicitly
    request actionable hypotheses for validation through macro HR@10

originality.positive: Connects model diagnostics to a constrained recommendation improvement loop through a stable adapter.
originality.negative: The description specifies an integration contract rather than a new recommendation algorithm or demonstrated diagnostic method.

future_potential.positive: Can support architecture comparisons and targeted experiments using consistent, auditable measurements.
future_potential.negative: Diagnostic usefulness must be established empirically; favorable probe values need not improve validation HR@10.

code_difficulty.positive: The required interfaces and batch structure are explicit, making an initial SASRec implementation straightforward.
code_difficulty.negative: Architecture changes require careful feature alignment, masking, state restoration, and consistent inference serialization.
